verdict.rationale: Bevy is code-first: it is "just a normal Rust dependency" added to an ordinary Rust project, and a runtime probe confirms the cargo workflow needs no editor to drive. Building from the command line without clicking through an editor is therefore inherent to how the product works, and it targets all major platforms. missing for 10: explicit documentation of headless CI builds, documented export/packaging steps per target platform (e.g., web/mobile bundles), independent hands-on CI corroboration.
